hints.title: Write the selected GP terms
hints.body: The first, second and fourth GP terms are 4, 4r and 4r3. In an AP, twice the middle term equals the sum of the outer terms.
hints.recap: Use the exact term positions to connect an AP and a GP.
hints.pitfall: The fourth GP term contains <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math>, not <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>r</mi><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math>.

recall.reminder: Use the exact term positions to connect an AP and a GP.

hints.title: Use the allowed ratio
hints.body: The equation becomes r3−2r+1=0=(r−1)(r2+r−1). Since 0<r<1, the factor r−1 cannot vanish.
hints.recap: Restrictions remove algebraic roots that do not describe the progression.
hints.pitfall: Do not keep <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> merely because it solves the factored equation.
hints.pause: Solve the remaining quadratic and select its positive root.

recall.reminder: Restrictions remove algebraic roots that do not describe the progression.

hints.title: Sum and simplify
hints.body: Use the convergent geometric-series formula: divide the first term by one minus your permitted ratio. If a square root remains in the denominator, multiply numerator and denominator by its conjugate.
hints.recap: Check convergence, then use the GP sum to infinity.
hints.pitfall: The question asks for the series sum rather than its ratio.
hints.pause: Substitute your ratio, evaluate the sum and rationalise the resulting denominator.

recall.reminder: Check convergence, then use the GP sum to infinity.

solution:
The AP condition is 2(4r)=4+4r3, so r3−2r+1=0. Factorising gives (r−1)(r2+r−1)=0. The condition 0<r<1 excludes r=1 and the negative quadratic root, leaving r=5−12.

Its magnitude is below 1, so the GP sums to 41−r=83−5. Rationalising gives 8(3+5)9−5=2(3+5), option D.
knowledgePattern: Interlock AP condition and convergent GP
